title: Tariff Run
description: Carry a sealed manifest of taxed goods between two Concord customs houses without breaking the seal.

title: Ledger Audit
description: Escort a Concord auditor through contested territory to inspect a border warehouse.

title: Concord Charter
description: Petition for a chartered factor's seal, binding your caravan to the Concord's protection and its rules.

title: Blockade Run
description: Slip a wagon of untaxed goods past a Concord checkpoint under cover of night.

title: Smuggler's Favor
description: Deliver a Free Caravans courier's parcel to Redgate without asking what's inside.

title: Caravan Oath
description: Swear the Free Caravans' oath before the outrider captains at Cinderhold, forsaking any Concord charter.
